explanation.value: Insert every unsafe word into a trie and mark the nodes where words end. To test a text, start a walk at each position: follow the trie as long as the next character has a child, and report unsafe as soon as an end marker is reached. Because unsafe words are at most 20 characters long, each walk takes at most 20 steps, so a text of length L costs at most 20L steps regardless of how many unsafe words there are.
